end.summary:
Interpreted position-time and velocity-time graphs as motion stories.
Plotted and read x-t graphs; used slope to find velocity.
Read v-t graphs; used slope for acceleration and area for distance.
Initially said a constant-acceleration v-t graph would curve, then corrected this to a straight line using v = u + at.
end.parentNote: Ira practised reading graph shape, slope, and area as motion information rather than as a path. They correctly found velocity as 3 m/s, acceleration as 2.5 m/s², and distance as 20 m using the triangle-area method. The initial mix-up about a curved v-t graph was corrected later by linking constant acceleration to v = u + at. At home, ask Ira to explain one graph in words and identify its slope or area before calculating.
